question: Why is the Lord called Vama in this context?
premises: The Lord has consciousness as his single body.
He desires to make the universe his own within consciousness.
This occurs through the emission of his own awareness-power.
inference: Because he emits his awareness-power to appropriate the universe, that Lord is called Vama.
plain_english: That Lord, whose single body is consciousness, desiring to make the universe his own within the self of consciousness through the emission of his own power of awareness, is called Vama.
